subject: FVD status: variance study + memory risk
body:
Hi Daniela,

Status: the FVD library is integrated in both target repos and matches the open-source reference to four decimals on the smoke suite.

Finding from the variance study: at 512 videos per side, FVD moves about 3% across seeds — enough to flip rankings between checkpoints that are close. At 2048 videos the spread drops under 1%. Recommendation: standardize on 2048.

Risk: the I3D embedding step is memory-hungry for clips beyond 64 frames because the whole [N, T, 224, 224, 3] tensor is materialized before create_id3_embedding runs. I am chunking along the batch dimension, which drops peak memory roughly 4x, but the sweep budget needs to assume the slower chunked path.

Quentin
